title: Appoint a Director Retiring by Rotation (AGM)
description: The standard AGM ordinary resolution reappointing (or appointing a replacement for) a director who retires by rotation.
mcaForms: DIR-12 (only if a new person is appointed)
records: Notice of AGM with Explanatory Statement (if applicable)

questions.label: Has the retiring director offered themselves for reappointment?
Include a Section 102 Explanatory Statement with this resolution?
questions.tooltip: The bare resolution text is what gets voted on; the Explanatory Statement is the business rationale attached to the AGM notice.

questions.label: Business rationale for reappointment (for the Explanatory Statement)

template.agendaTitle: To appoint a Director in place of {{director_name}}, who retires by rotation
template.proposal: {{director_name}} (DIN {{din}}) retires by rotation at the {{agm_ordinal}} Annual General Meeting and{{#if seeks_reappointment}}, being eligible, offers themselves for reappointment{{else}} does not seek reappointment{{/if}}. Members are requested to consider and, if thought fit, pass the following resolution as an Ordinary Resolution.
template.body: "RESOLVED THAT {{director_name}} (DIN {{din}}), who retires by rotation at this {{agm_ordinal}} Annual General Meeting of the Company{{#if seeks_reappointment}} and, being eligible, has offered themselves for reappointment,{{/if}} be and is hereby appointed as a Director of the Company, liable to retire by rotation."
template.explanatoryStatement: Pursuant to Section 152 of the Companies Act, 2013, {{director_name}} retires by rotation at this {{agm_ordinal}} Annual General Meeting. {{rationale}} The Board recommends the Ordinary Resolution for approval by the members. None of the Directors or Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, other than {{director_name}}, is concerned or interested, financially or otherwise, in this resolution.
template.minutesGist: Meeting held on {{meeting_date}} at {{meeting_place}}. Members considered the reappointment of {{director_name}} (DIN {{din}}), who retired by rotation at the {{agm_ordinal}} AGM, and passed the Ordinary Resolution set out above.

include_explanatory_statement.meaning: Section 102 requires an Explanatory Statement for special business; routine retirement-by-rotation reappointments are usually ordinary business, but many companies attach a short statement anyway for clarity.
